name: Greece

child benefit: categories of equivalised family income (lookup with notches), written in the country

validation.referee: OECD TW 2025 at the OECD's own gross (oecd/check_gr.py)
validation.notes: 8 types x 7 lines (CGTC CGITLETC CGITFP SLT EECSSC CTGG THP); largest diff 0.47 EUR from whole-euro wages

headline: Greece's 44 % top rate is really 46 % up to 91,000 EUR (the art. 16 reduction is withdrawn above it), child benefit drops 671 EUR at a 2 EUR raise, and art. 16 gives two amounts for five children; the model matches OECD Taxing Wages 168/168 lines (2023-2025) at the OECD's own gross.
